newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra names new ASIO Head.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra names new ASIO Head.

text.p: Australia on Thursday named a new chief spy for its main internal intelligence agency.
Senior bureaucrat Dennis Richardson will take over as head of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation (ASIO) next month, Attorney-General Daryl Williams said in a statement.
He replaces outgoing director-general David Sadleir.
Richardson will guide ASIO as it prepares for the security challenge of the 2000 Olympic Games in Sydney, Williams said.
Richardson, a deputy secretary in the Department of Immigration and Multicultural Affairs, has held senior posts in foreign policy, defence and intelligence.
He conducted a 1992 major review of Australia's intelligence operations in the post-Cold War era.
